title: Action Wanded!
description: Replaces the 26w14a action items with wands!
body:
![A title image that says "Action Wanded!"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fcc467a837319501ad72c519a3185a6420b80ae.png)
_This looks so cool, thank you Ewan Howell for the minecraft title blockbench plugin_
 
![An empty image for formatting purposes.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47f3ad41cbddb73f4fd5fab47c2447f72528e85a_0.webp)

You know those _uninspired_ action items that look like garbage? I didn't like them, so I made this.

Replaces the default item model for every "Action" item with a cool wand!

Now you can command all those blocks and items with a cool wand thing instead of a flat texture.

![An empty image for formatting purposes.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/47f3ad41cbddb73f4fd5fab47c2447f72528e85a_0.webp)

![A screenshot of my character holding the "Move" item that is a wand.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/68aa214ca9db061ea48a28ce31923b58f482e5c3.jpeg)
